rgb: The scene takes place inside a retail clothing store where the camera wearer holds a smartphone in both hands at the bottom center, about 3 to 5 m away and out of reach, beside a clothing rack of hanging sweaters and jeans extending from 3 to 5 m on the left. To the front-right of the camera wearer, a man in a brown shirt, blue jeans, and tan shoes stands about 3 to 5 m away and roughly 0.5 m to the right of the jeans on the rack, placing the rack out of reach of both him and the camera wearer. In frames 1 through 4, the camera points downward toward the floor and smartphone, cropping the man above the waist or chest as he pivots counterclockwise from facing left in frame 1 to facing directly away from the camera wearer by frame 2 while stepping slightly farther away. During these first four frames, the held smartphone and the camera wearer's hands partially occlude the floor in the distant background, while the upper half of the room and the man's head remain out of view above the top frame edge. In frame 5, the camera tilts upward to eye level, cutting off the man's lower body below the chest and the lower part of the rack while revealing his head facing and looking away from the camera wearer at about 3 to 5 m on the right, a slatted wall 2.5 m behind him, and a second person in dark clothing facing toward the camera wearer about 0.5 to 1.5 m away near a doorway on the back left, partly occluded by the top of the clothing rack.
depth: In a retail clothing area, the depth map shows the camera wearer's hand holding a smartphone at bottom-center out of reach (about 3–5 m away, brightest white), a clothing rack with hanging trousers and sweaters on the left at 3–5 m (out of reach of both the wearer and the distant man), and a man standing to the right at roughly 3–5 m away, about 0.5–0.8 m right of the rack. In frames 1–4 the camera looks downward so the man's upper body is cropped above the frame while he shifts his stance slightly and faces away from the wearer; in frame 5 the camera pitches up to show the man's torso and head facing and looking away from the wearer at ~3–5 m on the right, while the rack with hangers (~3–5 m) partially occludes a second person standing nearby behind it on the left (~0.5–1.5 m) in front of a rear wall and doorway (~0.3–1.5 m). The continuous brightness gradients make the sloped floor plane, the layered depth of individual hanging garments on the left rack, and the step in distance between the background rack and foreground doorway clearer than in RGB alone. However, the depth map is unreliable around the thin metal rack legs, where the man's shoes blend into the floor luminance in frames 1–4, and along the upper foreground wall in frame 1 where depth drops to black.
segmentation: The segmentation map isolates the standing man on the right (`person` mask) at ~3–5 m from the camera wearer and the wearer's own hands and handheld phone (`person` and `cell phone` masks) at ~3–5 m in the bottom background, out of the wearer's arm's reach. Across frames 1–4, only the lower body and legs of the man on the right are visible in the downward view as his feet turn slightly away from the wearer, while the wearer's left thumb partially occludes the phone screen; in frame 5, the camera tilts up to reveal the man's head and torso facing away from the wearer on the right, a nearby foreground person partly occluded behind him on the far right (~0.5–1.5 m), and a person on the left (~2 m, facing toward the wearer) partly occluded by the background clothing rack (~3–5 m). Compared to RGB, the masks sharply delineate the boundary between the wearer's fingers and the phone in frame 2 and separate the overlapping people on the far right and far left in frame 5. However, the map is highly unreliable on the clothing racks and accessories: it misses the phone in frames 1, 4, and 5, misclassifies the hanging jeans (~3–5 m on the left, out of arm's reach) as a `person` in frames 2 and 4 and the left-hand sweater rack as a `suitcase` in frame 3, and in frame 5 mislabels the man's lanyard as a `tie` and the background hangers and clothes as a `bed` and `person`.
pose: The pose map tracks skeletal keypoints in only two of the five frames, showing the standing man on the right at roughly 3–5 m from the camera wearer (and ~0.5–0.8 m right of the clothing rack) while leaving the distant hands, phone (~3–5 m), and surrounding racks (~3–5 m, out of arm's reach) unmapped on the black background. In frame 1, yellow body keypoints map the man's crossed arms, torso, hips, knees, and ankles on the right—with his head cropped out of view above the top edge—showing his body angled toward the left and facing roughly away from the camera wearer. Across frames 2–4, as the camera remains angled downward and only the man's waist and legs remain in view, all body and hand skeletons disappear completely. In frame 5, after the camera tilts upward, a cluster of yellow facial keypoints and a horizontal shoulder bar appear on the right at ~3–5 m, confirming that the man's shoulders and face are oriented directly away from the camera wearer while his lower body is cropped below the frame. The skeleton in frame 1 clarifies the exact joint positions of his folded arms and hip-to-ankle alignment under loose clothing better than RGB alone, but the map is unreliable because it fails to detect his visible legs in frames 2–4, misses the wearer's distant hands in all frames, and omits the two partially occluded nearby people in frame 5.
